look.text: Look at the array. Count the rows, then count the dots in each row.

boost.text: 5 × 1 means 5 rows with 1 dot in each.

add_for_multiply.text: 5 + 1 is adding. Here there are 5 rows with 1 dot in each.

neighbour_row.text: Count the rows again. There are 5 rows.

off_by_small.text: You are close. Count the dots one by one.

other_wrong.text: Each row has 1 dot. Count all the dots.

add_for_multiply.text: 5 + 5 adds only 2 fives. Here there are 5 groups of 5.

neighbour_row.text: Count the groups again. There are 5 groups, each with 5.

off_by_small.text: You are close. Count by 5 for each group.

digit_reversal.text: Check the order of the digits. Count by 5s: 5, 10, 15, and keep going.

same_decade.text: The tens are right. Check the ones: counting by 5 ends in 0 or 5.

other_wrong.text: There are 5 groups with 5 in each. Count by 5 for every group.

boost.text: 7 × 5 is 7 jumps of 5 on the number line.

add_for_multiply.text: 7 + 5 is adding. Here there are 7 jumps, and each jump is 5.

neighbour_row.text: Count the jumps again. There are 7 of them.

off_by_small.text: You are close. Each jump is 5, so the number ends in 0 or 5.

digit_reversal.text: Check the order of the digits. Read the number where the last jump lands.

same_decade.text: The tens are right. Look at where the 7th jump lands.

other_wrong.text: Count by 5 for each jump: 5, 10, 15, and keep going.
8 tens is 8 groups of 10. Count by 10 for each group.
There are 7 rows with 10 in each. Count the rows by 10s.

add_for_multiply.text: 5 + 8 is adding. Here there are 5 rows with 8 in each.

neighbour_row.text: That is one 8 too many or too few. There are 5 rows of 8.

off_by_small.text: You are close. Counting by 5 always ends in 0 or 5.

digit_reversal.text: Check the order of the digits in your number.

same_decade.text: The tens are right. Count the last few fives again.

other_wrong.text: Count by 5 for each of the 8 groups.

changes.why: the English reviewer (workflows/_lang/en/checklist.md en-10) needs a question to end with ?; dl-e8ov.5.77 asks that every step pass it

boost.text: 10 × 5 is 10 fives. It is also 5 tens.

add_for_multiply.text: 10 + 5 is adding. Here there are 10 rows with 5 in each.

neighbour_row.text: Count the rows again. There are 10 rows of 5.

off_by_small.text: You are close. Count by 10 for each of the 5 columns.

digit_reversal.text: Check where each digit goes. Count by 10, 5 times.

same_decade.text: You have the right tens. Count the 10 rows of 5 again.

other_wrong.text: Count by 5 for each of the 10 rows.

boost.text: 10 × 2 is 2 columns with 10 dots in each. Count by 10s.

add_for_multiply.text: 10 + 2 is adding. Here there are 10 rows with 2 dots in each.

neighbour_row.text: Count the rows again. There are 10 rows of 2.

off_by_small.text: You are close. Count the 2 columns by 10s.

digit_reversal.text: Check where each digit goes. Count the 2 columns by 10s again.

same_decade.text: You have the right tens. Count every dot in the 2 columns again.

other_wrong.text: There are 2 columns of 10. Count by 10 for each column.
